note: How some 立绘 sit in a pass, by picture file: m in a small pass, f in a whole pass, p peeking out of a roach's card on the map, each [left, top, width, height] in % of that picture box. The img is laid out as exactly that rectangle and the box clips it, where it would otherwise fill the box (object-fit: cover, from the top). A picture not listed, or a box not listed, fills its box as before; a picture changed has a new file name, so it is never moved by what was worked out for the old one.
